function exhaustive(action: Add | Remove) {
  switch (action.type) {
    case "add": return action.payload;
    case "remove": return;
    default:
      const checked: never = action;
      throw new UnhandledActionError(action as UnhandledAction);
  }
}

      throw new UnhandledActionError(raw as UnhandledAction);
  }
}

function exhaustShape(shape: Circle | Square) {
  switch (shape.kind) {
    case "circle": return shape.radius;
    case "square": return shape.side;
    default: return assertNever(shape as never);
  }
}
